heading: **23 March 2026**
body:
*Bead Preparation*

SBP: 2.5mL beads in 55mL blocking buff(salt free), dist 5 plates, 25uL/well

His: 4mL beads in 55mL blocking buff(salt free)

First take 2.5 mL of SBP beads and separate out the storage buffer and 4 mL of HIS beads and remove the storage buffer.

Resuspend both beads in 20 mL of Blocking buffer and incubate at RT, 10 mins.

Remove buffer and make up the volume to 55 mL for both beads.

*Wash Programs*

**Rinse with water – 5 secs**  
·   	**Prime with water – 5 secs**  
·   	**Prime with buffer – 5 secs**  
**Wash**

NCAP Wash  
**no soak, with shake wash (6+6+3)**

**HT Wash**  
**soak but NO shake wash (1+6+3+6+3+1)**  
Set up the HT wash program on the new washer.

*Wash Buffers*

1X NCAP Wash Buffer \= 200 mL 10X TCAPT Buffer \+ 400 uL 2-ME (Make up to 2 L) \[Prepare 2 bottles\]

0.5X NCAP Wash Buffer \= 100 mL 10X TCAPT Buffer \+ 400 uL 2-ME (Make up to 2 L) \[Prepare 2 bottles\]

HT-SELEX Buffers

| 10X Wash Buffer |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | STOCK | Final 10x: | 2 L |
| Tris pH 7.5 | 1M | 50mM | 100 mL |
| EDTA | 0.5M | 50mM | 200 mL |

Incubate the wash buffer in an ice bucket during use.  
Rinse and prime the washer before loading the beads plate.

Freshly prepare 1X buffer ⇒ 200 mL \+ 1800 mL water \+ 2 mL 1 M DTT. Prepare early during the day and chill the bottles at 4 degrees. \[Prepare 2 bottles\]
title: Bead Preparation
